test_title: PYST 37: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word from the following sentence.

Damage

Every war in the history originates because of the greed of the rulers which was satisfied after mass destruction.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Destruction**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Damage"** refers to physical harm that impairs the value, usefulness, or normal function of something. (नुकसान)
 
 
• **Example: **The storm caused significant damage to the coastal buildings.
 
 
 
• **"Destruction" **refers to the act of causing so much damage to something that it no longer exists or cannot be repaired; it is about making something completely unusable or annihilating it. (विनाश)
 
 
• **Example: **The wildfire led to the destruction of thousands of acres of forest.
 
 
 
• Therefore, we can infer that the synonym for **'Damage' **is **'Destruction'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Destruction**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Satisfied **(संतुष्ट): Feeling that one's needs or desires have been met.
 
 
• **Example:** She was satisfied with the results of her hard work.
 
 
 
• **Greed **(लालच): Intense and selfish desire for something, especially wealth, power, or food.
 
 
• **Example: **Greed for money can lead to unethical behavior.
 
 
 
• **Originates** (उत्पन्न होना): To begin, arise, or be derived from.
 
 
• **Example:** The concept of democracy originates from ancient Greece.
